def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    colors={v for row in grid for v in row}
    fg=max(colors) # updated below
    bg=min(colors)
    # Most frequent color is background; rarer non-background color is motif.
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg=max((v for v in colors if v!=bg), key=lambda v:c[v])
    fill=2 if fg==1 else (fg-1 if fg>1 else 2)
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for j in range(1,len(row)-1):
            if row[j]==bg and row[j-1]==fg and row[j+1]==fg:
                out[r][j]=fill
    return out
